findings.label: Workers Free release eligibility
findings.finding: Deployed PBKDF2/login-spike CPU, D1 quota, final-host browser cookies, and disposable restore remain unchecked.
findings.action: Run every fixed-security staging gate and block cutover on any failure.

findings.label: Money precision bounds
findings.finding: Bills, expenses, rentals, salary columns, and document line totals can exceed their source decimal precision.
findings.action: Enforce field-specific maxima in request/calculation code and matching D1 CHECK constraints.

findings.label: Malformed JWT signature response
findings.finding: Invalid Base64url in the signature segment returns 500 instead of generic 401.
findings.action: Guard all token-segment decoding and add a malformed-signature contract test.

findings.label: Custom-domain edge rate-limit instructions

findings.action: Add a dashboard walkthrough without replacing the in-Worker limiter.
